name: Practice: Full Run-Through
instructions: Play through your C major scale, two or three chords, and your best song, back to back, as one continuous session.
Treat any stumble as information, not failure -- note where it happened and give that spot extra attention tomorrow.
Notice your overall hand comfort and relaxation compared to your very first session at the keyboard.
Revisit today's chord-building video as a reference during your run-through.
